honest_verdict.satisfied_by: verdict built from gate_g1 + quality_maintained evaluation

n_steps.principle: >=200 — the depth at which prior loops collapsed.

initial_true_accuracy.principle: starting TRUE accuracy — MUST be in [0.3,0.6] (the non-degenerate gate; exp3533's was 0.0067).

nondegenerate_corpus_gate_passed.principle: boolean: starting true accuracy >= 0.3 — quality-maintenance is now measurable.

conservative_default_beta.principle: the deployed beta value (from exp3521) — the rule under test.

deployed_alpha_t_margin.principle: the alpha_t-grounding margin sustained over the loop — the Zenil grounding signal.

collapse_detected_deploy_arm.principle: collapse under the conservative-default beta — should be False (the deployment claim).

collapse_detected_control_beta0.principle: collapse under beta=0 — should be True (proves the loop CAN collapse on this corpus).
collapse_detected_control_beta0.satisfied_by: _collapse_criterion at N=200 depth with no entropy regularization

deploy_arm_final_true_accuracy.principle: true ground-truth accuracy at N under the deployed rule — output quality on a corpus where quality is measurable.
deploy_arm_final_true_accuracy.satisfied_by: probability-weighted sum of is_correct at N=200

quality_maintained.principle: boolean: deploy_final_true_accuracy >= 0.9*initial_true_accuracy — the rule does not over-regularize away REAL capability.

pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_distinct_asse.principle: boolean: pass_rate and true_accuracy verified element-wise distinct at runtime — keeps it de-flagged.

random_seed.principle: determinism; content-derived, not the experiment number.

reproducibility_checksum.satisfied_by: sha256[:16] of JSON-encoded (n_traces, seed, n_iter, beta, config)

duration_s.principle: cached-trace closed-loop sweep to N>=200; 1s floor.

experiment_title: FR-11 Conservative-Default Beta Deploy Non-Degenerate Corpus v3
